info.title: Quorum API
info.description:
The `/v1` API of a Quorum server: the single contract for adapters, the CLI and the web UI.

Rules that apply to every request:
- Every request except `GET /v1/health` and `POST /v1/hello` needs a bearer token, also on loopback (INV-23).
- Clients send no credential until `POST /v1/hello` has proven the server holds the key they pinned (INV-24).
- In local mode the server rejects requests whose `Host` is not its own loopback name and port, and state-changing requests from a foreign `Origin` (INV-26).
- Every error uses the `ErrorResponse` shape: a stable `code`, what happened, and the exact `fix` (MESSAGE_SPEC §6). Errors never echo secrets or tokens.
- Rate limits and quotas apply per principal; `429` responses carry `Retry-After` (INV-15).

servers.description: Local mode (port from the private discovery file)
Remote mode (Tailscale, Cloudflare Tunnel or LAN with TLS)

get.summary: Is the server up? Never needs a token.

post.summary: Prove the server identity before any credential is sent (INV-24).
post.description: The server signs, with its Ed25519 instance key, the UTF-8 bytes of `"quorum/1 hello\n" + instance_id + "\n" + nonce`. The client verifies the signature with the public key it pinned (private discovery file in local mode, join code in remote mode) and aborts on mismatch, without falling back.

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a new token pair (rotation).
post.description: Each refresh token works once. Reusing a rotated refresh token revokes the whole token family (INV-11).

200.description: New tokens. The old refresh token is now invalid.

post.summary: Local mode: exchange the one-time bootstrap code for the owner's human tokens.
post.description:
The local server writes a bootstrap code (`qrm_bc_…`, 10-minute expiry, single use) into its private data directory at `<data>/local/bootstrap.json`. Only the owning OS user can read it (INV-25), so presenting it proves the caller is that user. The first exchange creates the owner human.

Remote mode answers `404`: there, humans sign in with join codes (Phase 1b).

200.description: The owner human and their tokens. The code is now used up.

get.summary: Workspaces visible to the caller (agents: those their attachment grants).

post.summary: Bind a folder for one vendor to workspaces and issue agent credentials (`quorum attach`).
post.description: Humans only: an agent can never attach itself or widen its own visibility (INV-30). Credentials are returned once; the CLI stores them in the OS keychain (INV-11, INV-25). The root must not be inside the Quorum data directory.

patch.summary: Change wake mode, wake types or lease enforcement of an attachment.
patch.description: Humans only. The change applies from the next message and is recorded in the event log. Wake settings can never exceed the workspace's wake budget and loop pause (INV-29).

delete.summary: Detach a folder (`quorum detach`); revokes its agent credentials.

post.summary: Register a live vendor session for the calling agent.
post.description: The server assigns stable repository and worktree IDs from the canonical git paths and reports other live agents in the same working tree (INV-28).

delete.summary: End a session (the vendor session closed).

post.summary: Send a message (any type the caller is allowed to send).
post.description:
Validated against `SubmittedEnvelope`. `from` must match the token (INV-7); agents can never send `approval_decision` (INV-1); bodies are scanned for secrets (INV-14).

Idempotent by `(workspace, id)`: resending identical content returns `200` with the original result; different content under the same `id` returns `409` (MESSAGE_SPEC §2.1.3).

`heartbeat` messages update presence and are not stored in the event log (MESSAGE_SPEC §5.10).

200.description: Already accepted earlier with identical content.

get.summary: Messages addressed to the caller (directly or via `*`), oldest first.
get.description: For agents that cannot hold a stream open, e.g. between turns. Delivery is at-least-once; dedupe by `id`.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Return messages with `seq` greater than this. Omitted: start after the caller's last acknowledged `seq` (0 if none), so a restarted client does not replay mail it already acknowledged. `after=0` always starts from the beginning.

post.summary: Mark messages up to a `seq` as read for the caller.

get.summary: Live push of messages visible to the caller (Server-Sent Events).
get.description: Each event is `event: message`, `id: <seq>`, `data: <DeliveredEnvelope JSON>`. Reconnect with `Last-Event-ID` to receive everything after that `seq`: no message is lost across reconnects (MESSAGE_SPEC §4). The server closes the stream when the caller is revoked (INV-13).

get.summary: Messages in one thread that the caller may see, oldest first.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Return messages with `seq` greater than this. 0 = from the beginning.

get.summary: Agents in the workspace with their presence and current status.
get.description: An agent is `online` while it has sent a heartbeat within the last 90 seconds (MESSAGE_SPEC §5.10). `folder` is the name of the attached folder (e.g. `api`), never a full path.

post.summary: Revoke an agent immediately: tokens stop working and its streams close (INV-13).

get.summary: The workspace event log as JSON Lines, for `quorum verify` (INV-8).
get.description: One `Event` per line, oldest first. Tokens and secrets are never included (INV-11).

agentToken.description: Access token issued to an agent at attach time (1 h; refresh to rotate).

humanToken.description: Access token of a human (CLI). The web UI uses a session cookie instead.

BadRequest.description: The request does not match the schema; `path` points at the problem.

Forbidden.description: The token's scope does not allow this.

NotFound.description: No such object visible to the caller.

Conflict.description: Conflicts with existing state (e.g. same message `id`, different content).

PayloadTooLarge.description: The body exceeds 96 KiB; put large content in an artifact.
